name: Flanks Aggregate
description: Flanks Aggregate gives Claude secure, read-only access to a user's financial data aggregated by Flanks — a regulated open banking platform operating across Europe. Once connected via OAuth, Claude can list bank and broker credentials, fetch portfolio balances, query investment holdings with ISIN-level detail, and retrieve historical investment transactions. It also supports the full Flanks Connect flow: discovering available bank connectors, initiating new connection sessions, and monitoring session status. All data comes from Flanks' latest stored snapshot, ensuring fast responses without live bank calls.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flanks Aggregate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flanks Aggregate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://flanks-mcp.flanks.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flanks Aggregate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flanks Aggregate provides these MCP tools: flanks-connectors, flanks-create-connect-session, flanks-session-status, flanks-credential-status, flanks-needs-relogin, flanks-credentials, flanks-portfolios, flanks-investments, flanks-investment-transactions, and flanks-delete-credentials.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flanks Aggregate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flanks Aggregate in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Flanks Aggregate MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flanks Aggregate requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flanks Aggregate is developed by Flanks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
